sara_cs: FYI onboarding flow failures for a subset of trial customers since 10:20 PT — signup API hit tokenization errors + 5-8s extra latency. Logging points to a model-variant selector issue. tagging eng + support.

anthony_support: digging in, seeing 502s from embed-service and a retry storm. Escalating to eng-runtime. @deploy-bot triggered a regional fallback for affected routes.

deploy-bot: Rollback triggered: model redwood-v2-small -> redwood-v1.9 for route /api/v1/generate in us-west-2. Rollback completed 10:41 PT. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-fallback

jordan_onboarding: Can we get the list of onboarding customers who hit failures? Need to prioritize outreach for those in active trials.

anthony_support: quick list (summary): acme-inc, brighter-ai, learnflow — all in trial. ACME saw ~40% failure on first-run. I'll DM full logs and sample request/response.

marie_ae: ACME + LearnFlow are on renewal/watch lists; ACME has an exec demo Monday morning. We need a short customer note and a remediation plan before EOD.

sara_cs: Drafting outbound now. Proposed short note below — please review quickly: ```Hi <customer>, we experienced an upstream model routing issue impacting some onboarding flows between 10:20–10:40 PT. We've rolled back to a stable model and mitigations are in place. We're scheduling a dedicated session to re-run your onboarding and will credit any failed runs. Full RCA to follow. — Sara, CSM```

mike_csm: LGTM. Please add one line offering a 1:1 replay + 10% consumption credit for failed runs. Also mark ACME as priority for the replay slot. :+1:

jordan_onboarding: I'll book replay sessions for the three customers. Plan: 30-min technical replay + success checklist. Ops note: change model tag to redwood-v1.9 in their config until v2 is validated.

anthony_support: Root cause summary for the RCA: model-variant selector failed to fall back cleanly when sequence length exceeded the configured threshold, which triggered a tokenization fallback path error. Fix deployed: tightened selector logic + added e2e test for long-sequence routing. Patch merged at 11:05 PT; monitoring alerted green at 11:20 PT. Full RCA being drafted in the incident doc.

sara_cs: Perfect. I'll send the customer note now and book the ACME priority slot. @marie_ae can you join the ACME call for account context? We'll offer the credit in the note.

marie_ae: Yes, I'll join. Also please add an opportunity-level note in Salesforce: "Incident: model routing issue; priority replay scheduled; credit offered; follow-up in 48h."

mike_csm: Outreach cadence suggestion: send the customer message now, follow up in 4 hours if no response, escalate to AE for execs if still no reply. Recommend a proactive calendar invite for replays to reduce friction.

ops_incident_bot: Incident 2026-03-20-187 recorded: model routing error -> mitigation complete. RCA draft saved: /internal/incidents/179875-db-routing.json.

sara_cs: Closing coordination thread. Action items recap: 1) outbound sent (10:55 PT), 2) 30-min replays booked for ACME/Brighter-LearnFlow, 3) credits offered/pending reconciliation, 4) customer-facing RCA by EOD. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
